args.body:
Jo,

Flagging NQ70418326 (Alex Morgan, shelf D-0187, contents: family correspondence and photographs) ahead of today's release.

If permission is not registered by 13:30 I will release the manifest with this box on it, as policy requires, and record the outcome. I will not hold the batch of 60 for it.

Copying Miriam.

A request logged in good time for the next sitting can never reach a box staged on a Monday or a Wednesday, so the register structurally cannot protect those boxes.
